args.code: (() => { const npcs = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[class*="npc"], .npc-item, .npc-card')).map(el => el.innerText).filter(t => t); const skills = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[class*="skill"], .skill-item, .skill-card')).map(el => el.innerText).filter(t => t); const fields = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[class*="field"], .field-item, .field-cell')).map(el => el.innerText).filter(t => t); const tasks = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[class*="task"], .task-item, .mission-item')).map(el => el.innerText).filter(t => t); const weather = document.querySelector('[class*="weather"], .weather-info, .weather-display'); const money = document.querySelector('[class*="money"], .gold-display, .currency'); return JSON.stringify({npcCount: npcs.length, npcs: npcs.slice(0,10), skillCount: skills.length, skills: skills.slice(0,10), fieldCount: fields.length, fields: fields.slice(0,10), taskCount: tasks.length, tasks: tasks.slice(0,10), weatherText: weather ? weather.innerText : null, moneyText: money ? money.innerText : null}); })()
